pain_point: Cash flow concerns during construction - If I buy off the plan when do I actually start paying? I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time
headline_outcome: Pay a Deposit. That's It for Now.
primary_text: "If I buy off the plan, when do I actually start paying?" Just the deposit. That's all you pay until your Truganina warehouse is built and ready for handover. Your mortgage kicks in at settlement — not before. So you keep operating from your current space, paying your current rent, and running your business as normal. When construction completes, you walk out of your rental and into your own warehouse. One door closes, another opens — and your rent payment becomes a mortgage payment that builds equity. No juggling two payments. No cash flow squeeze. Off-the-plan is designed for exactly this situation. Let us walk you through the timeline.
description: Keep operating from your current space with zero extra costs during the build
